Ripped off
Nov 2024 • Solo
It's chocolate milk not a milkshake! It looks nice, but It's a rip-off! This is the second time I've tried it. I tried vanilla the first time. I told him how bad it was and they promised they would change the recipe. So I tried the chocolate and it was the same. It is a real simple recipe, ice cream blended with milk sugar and flavoring... That's it. How can you mess that up? How can you charge 105k for chocolate milk? And then they top it off with this very bland whipped cream..... Don't mix it in it only makes things taste worse. And they use an extra thin straw that would be impossible to use on real milkshakes. I'm never going back. I feel like they baited me to come back again by saying they'd fix the problem. Their hamburgers are okay but nothing special. Just try somewhere else... Not Al Fresco's

Tasty food but needed to be warmer and on the pricey side
Sep 2023 • Couples
We ended up here by accident after finding our regular burger place was unexpectedly shut due to power issues.
The staff are young but very friendly and welcoming and have good English. I like the decor of the place, however advise against sitting underneath the air con unit as we did as we got dripped water on.
They have a good menu selection and offers, the food wasn't too quick and was fairly cold by the time it arrived, but was super tasty just needed to be hotter. We enjoyed cherry beer to top off the meal. I did however find this place very expensive by hanoi standards as everything is priced minus VAT and service charge on the menu so even with their deals it was pricey!

Best burger place in town!!
Apr 2023 • Friends
The last review I did for Chops was back in July 11, 2017. Over the years I must have either eaten at location or ordered home from there well over 100 times.

Their burgers have gotten even more amazing over time and its definitely worth the value. Their staff in all their locations are well-trained, very polite and attentive.

Their quality is consistent in all their locations. I've been to their 3 locations in Tay Ho, Giang Vo & Ngoc Khanh.

I'll definitely keep going back for another 100 times. Good job to the Management Team of Chops for maintaining/improving your quality despite the success.

Can't fault it - good burgers and great brekkie.
Dec 2022
I stopped in for a takeaway burger on the way home from the pub and was seriously impressed so I tried brekkie as well. The burger was amazing (once I got the pickles out obviously), very large and tasty. Fries were great. The breakfast is huge - pork ribs, bacon, hashbrowns etc. Too much for me and put me in a food coma for the morning. Service is pretty good, good English speaking which is good for me as after six weeks I can't even say thank you properly. Well worth a look and I will be back if in Hanoi looking for a burger fix.
